requested_outcome: Make the event rail continue beyond the three currently verified offers, preserve truthful availability labels, and publish the verified correction.
authorization_boundary: Implement, test, commit, push and publish the event-rail correction. Do not invent availability, submit a booking, change supplier records, DNS, credentials or database schema.

lesson_bundle.reason: The same public defect was reported repeatedly.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify the exact public rail, controls and visible card count after publication.
Record exact candidate, public release and rollback identity.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The rail still ends after three cards.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Append real published event venues up to the 20-card product limit after verified offers.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and mobile expose enabled continuation controls and more than three distinct cards.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Extra venues are falsely shown as available.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Give only supplier-confirmed offers date, slot and price; label other venues as requiring an availability check.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No browse-only card contains the verified-availability label.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The code changed but the public site is still old.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish the exact tested commit and inspect the public destination.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public release identity and visible behavior match the candidate.

sources.label: Vacation rail
sources.source: app/components/home-live-deals.tsx uses bounded horizontal continuation and preserves useful cards during refresh.

sources.label: VII feedback standard

midpoint_gate.trigger: After source diagnosis and the first focused tests.
checks: Confirm the public API returns three verified offers.
Confirm the candidate renders up to 20 real venues without adding availability claims.

attack_questions: Does the rail still stop at three?
Can an unverified card look available?
Is the public version the tested commit?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Public desktop and 390px browser inspection after release.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full suite, production build and public visual exercise.

effectiveness.baseline: The public event rail returned three stale verified offers and therefore had no continuation.
effectiveness.target: A truthful event rail with more than three real venues and working continuation on the public site.
